scenario: `t in i` iff `i.start <= t < i.end` ([LINT.3.1.1]; LINT.9.2, the id, is a tombstone). A probe equal to `end` is outside the interval (end is exclusive). probe=20 on (10..20) does NOT fire.
rules_ds:
schema Window scope logical:
    start_t: Int key
    end_t: Int mutable
    probe: Int mutable

schema Hit scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule in_range:
    Window w where w.probe in (w.start_t..w.end_t)
->
    emit Hit logical dummy: 0
